18.o: When an armored truck heist ends in bloodshed, the team races to track down priceless jewels before more lives are lost; Hondo's mother, Charice, visits.

19.o: The team races to uncover the identities of kidnappers holding a prison guard's family hostage; Tan is faced with a difficult personal decision.

20.o: Following a string of violent home robberies, the team rushes to stop a crew targeting elderly victims; Hondo's longtime friend and former Marine squad leader Danny Wright turns to Hondo for help when his daughter goes missing.

21.o: SWAT teams up with the DEA, led by Mack Boyle, to conduct a massive gang sweep, only to discover that a vicious cartel is planting roots in the city and endangering numerous lives. Also, Hicks marks an important anniversary.

22.o: The team works with the DEA and their iron-jawed leader, Mack Boyle, to stop a ruthless cartel boss waging war on the streets of Los Angeles as he exacts revenge on those who killed his son.

1.o: The team heads to Mexico to escort a fugitive back to the States when things go awry and Hondo has to save an old witness tied to the case.

2.o: Hondo and Hicks desperately search for Powell, who's gone missing in Mexico City along with a thermobaric bomb capable of killing thousands. Deacon's pride gets injured in a boxing match with Rocker.

3.o: 20-Squad must leap into action when Yakuza assassins descend on L.A., targeting a number of mysterious Japanese ex-pats. Meanwhile, Nichelle finds her job on the line at the inspector general's office when a colleague accuses her of taking bribes.

4.o: SWAT hunts down a Chilean arms dealer after he kidnaps a woman and her daughter from a party in L.A. with unexpected intentions. Crossing paths with his brother, Tan is forced to come clean to his family about his divorce from Bonnie, while Hondo discovers that Hicks has received a job offer that could lure him away from SWAT.

5.o: While training with Long Beach SWAT, Street discovers a biker club has stolen a cache of armor-piercing bullets and brings 20-Squad into the hunt for the gang before they can pull off a daring and deadly heist. As Hondo struggles with changes at work, Nichelle finds herself at odds with her former colleague Bruce.

6.o: After a prison transport van overturns, Hondo and the team hunt down three female fugitives, including a serial killer on the verge of a rampage. Also, with Annie’s return to work, Deacon struggles to maintain a work life balance, and Luca does his best to teach Kelly to drive.

7.o: After the shocking shooting of a member of 20-Squad, Hondo and the team launch a citywide manhunt for the robbery crew responsible. Meanwhile, Deacon's plans for his future hit a snag, and Powell and Alfaro clash over a tricky issue.

8.o: The SWAT team faces off with a family of doomsday preppers barricaded inside their fortress of a home, and Deacon finds himself at the center of the storm. Also, Tan clashes with a reporter covering the situation and Powell grapples with meeting the child she gave up for adoption 18 years ago.

9.o: When a female robbery crew "honeytraps" and kills several rich VIPs, Hondo and 20-Squad are called in to assist FBI Agent Jackie Vasquez in capturing the dangerous fugitives before the death toll rises. Commander Hicks is shocked when his new love, Maggie, abruptly ends their relationship without rhyme or reason. With help from Deacon and Dr. Wendy, Hicks makes an important decision about his romantic future.

10.o: As 20-Squad scrambles to track down a cold-blooded sniper terrorizing Los Angeles, Hondo discovers a link to his own South L.A. neighborhood that brings a personal twist to the hunt for the deadly shooter. Meanwhile, Tan finds himself questioning his leadership abilities while Powell and Alfaro compete in a classic game of SWAT tag.

11.o: Tan finds himself on a one-man mission to save his new love interest and her journalist co-workers when mercenaries take over a black-tie correspondents' dinner. After the group escapes, it's up to SWAT to track down the well-trained gunmen.

12.o: When a crew of violent eco-terrorists abducts the teenage son of an energy company executive, SWAT must untangle the kidnappers' twisted motives before carrying out a high-stakes rescue mission. Meanwhile, Hondo's involvement in a shooting draws outrage from the very community he's dedicated his career to protecting. And, as Deacon is called on to help with the escalating crisis, he's forced to confront nagging doubts about his retirement.

13.o: SWAT faces their deadliest adversary yet when a violent cell of extremists looks to extract vengeance by blowing up half of Los Angeles, potentially killing thousands.

1.o: SWAT tackles a mission with personal ties for Hondo when they race to find a group of missing students and their bus driver, Hondo's former high school football coach. Also, Hicks has reservations regarding Hondo's new 20-Squad team addition, Devin Gamble, a cop with a family background deeply entrenched in crime.

2.o: When a spree of brutal stash house robberies spills into L.A., 20-Squad must team up with the sheriff's department's gang unit to unmask a violent crew who leaves no witness alive.

3.o: 20-Squad faces down a prison hostage situation, only to be thrown into deeper danger when a bomb explodes, freeing maximum-security prisoners from their cells, including someone with a personal grudge against Hondo.

4.o: A blackout throws the city into chaos, forcing 20-Squad onto the streets for an emergency patrol day, which quickly escalates when Hondo and team uncover a terror threat.

5.o: Tan is left reeling when his girlfriend is kidnapped, and 20-Squad must race to track down a violent cartel leader who may be behind the abduction.

6.o: When back-to-back shootings at women's clinics leave two healthcare providers dead, Hondo and the team investigate whether the shooting were politically motivated.

7.o: When two students are brutally attacked, 20-Squad contends with a possible honor killing. Meanwhile, Hondo and Nichelle have their first parenting dispute while searching for a suitable daycare.

8.o: Hondo and the S.W.A.T. team race to stop a nuclear attack on Los Angeles when radioactive material is stolen from a local lab.

9.o: When Hondo learns there’s a $1 million bounty on his head, 20-Squad must race to uncover the mysterious enemy from Hondo’s past who’s intent on revenge. Also, Deacon and Tan butt heads over Tan’s changes to S.W.A.T. academy.

10.o: 20-Squad contends with a hostage crisis. Also, Hondo receives a family visit.

11.o: The squad races to find a missing child who was abducted from her front yard; Hicks is faced with a difficult decision concerning Gamble.

12.o: While working undercover for 20-Squad, Alfaro encounters associates from a previous undercover case in Long Beach, embarking on a dangerous mission that stirs up unresolved issues from the past.

13.o: While hiking, Powell and Gamble discover an illegal marijuana farm and end up confronting a dangerous cartel.

14.o: When violent robbers loot a museum vault, Hondo and 20-Squad must chase down the thieving killers before they flee the country; Tan reckons with the fallout from a SWAT Academy accident; Gamble nervously awaits the verdict of her lA investigation.

15.o: S.W.A.T.'s anti-terror sting operation at a bus station is thrown into chaos when felons, fleeing the police, burst in and take the bus station hostage; Bennett redoubles her efforts to force Hicks out as S.W.A.T.'s  commander.

16.o: The abduction and brutal torture of two college football stars puts S.W.A.T. on the trail of a violent drug dealer looking to extract vengeance for a drug deal gone bad, while Deacon’s heroics bring unexpected attention on S.W.A.T.

17.o: When three of L.A.'s finest are targeted and gunned down in the street, the team enlist the help of an LAPD psychologist to stop a murderous rampage, reopening old wounds tied to the department's failed response to a school shooting.

18.o: When a violent shooting rocks a Los Angeles nightclub, Hondo and 20-Squad are thrust into the dark world of sex trafficking, going head-to-head with a notorious biker club as they race to find a missing girl.

19.o: After an explosive accident at a fruit-packing facility staffed by prison workers, six inmates escape and scatter across the city. Tasked with chasing down the fugitives, Hondo and 20-Squad discover that the worksite explosion was no accident, and that the escapees are working together to carry out a high-stakes robbery. Also, Commander Hicks packs up his office, preparing to vacate the SWAT commander's post, and Gamble gets sobering news about her jailed father.

20.o: When Hondo’s cousin goes AWOL from his Marine base during basic training, Hondo, Deacon and Daniel Sr. take a road trip to get the kid in line; Alfaro plots to work outside the law when he discovers that his mother’s abusive ex is back in her life.

21.o: When an auto carrier truck gets hijacked by a high-speed crew, Hondo encounters a ghost from his past - a violent car thief thought to be long-dead. The brutal road warriors tear across L.A. in pursuit of a mysterious $60 million car.

22.o: The SWAT team undertakes its final mission when a violent crew of ex-pat Russian mercenaries holds LA hostage after planting hundreds of explosives across the city.

1.o: Po and Monkey race to find a sacred orchid to cure a sick Tigress. But Monkey is hypnotized by the evil Scorpion into hunting down another target -- Po.

2.o: Po is put in charge of protecting the Emperor’s daughter while on a diplomatic trip to visit the Qidan clan. Luckily, Tigress and Mantis are along for the journey.

3.o: Po destroys the training hall whilst cleaning it and needs to repair it quickly before Shifu finds out. He seeks out the builder of the hall, Taotie, who holds a grudge against Shifu.

4.o: While transporting an important column, Po and Tigress’s attempt to defend it against bandits is complicated when they are chained together.

5.o: Po learns a new move by jumping ahead of reading fifty sacred scrolls and ends up wiping the memories of the Furious Five.

6.o: Po is tricked into saving the leader of the Croc Bandits’ brother when in fact he has kidnapped the son of a powerful landowner.

7.o: Mantis gets help from Po after receiving word his ex-fiancée needs help, which he is reluctant to take as his hometown believes Mantis to be the Dragon Warrior.

8.o: Po goes undercover as a prisoner in Chor Ghom Prison to learn where a diabolical criminal has hidden the ultra-dangerous weapon, the Sacred War Hammer of Lei Lang.

9.o: The Furious Five discover that Po has incredible kung fu abilities far beyond anyone else’s in the group. This worries them as they believe he will turn evil like Fenghuang, a member of the Furious Five before the current team who was also greatly powerful.

10.o: Po has split himself into two opposing parts by looking through the Mystic Mirror of Yin and Yang and needs to stop his duplicate from destroying his reputation and friendships with his bad personality traits.

11.o: When a villainous rival of Master Shifu manipulates Po into breaking an important rule, the consequences allow him to become Grand Master of the Jade Palace.

12.o: Hundun, a former guard at Chor Ghom prison, wants revenge against the Dragon Warrior for making him lose everything in his life as a result of defeating Tai Lung.

13.o: Shifu invites Mr. Ping to stay at the Jade Palace when his noodle shop is badly damaged during a fight between Po, Monkey and three pig brothers. This causes tension between him and the others until he is asked to leave and is subsequently captured by the pig brothers believing him to be Master Shifu.

14.o: Po encounters the ghost of Master Oogway, who seems strangely bent on causing dissension in the Jade Palace.

15.o: When a kung fu prodigy arrives at the Jade Palace, Po’s enthusiasm begins to sour when he gets a little jealous of the attention being heaped onto the young master.

16.o: Po befriends a troupe of dancers, unaware that they are actually a band of traveling thieves. When a prized item goes missing from the Jade Palace, Po has to disguise himself to infiltrate the band.

17.o: Po must look after Taotie's son after he is taken to prison after a failed attack on the Jade Palace. His loyalties are split when he tries to help his father get out of prison though he has warmed to Po.

18.o: Po finds he has a fan club in the valley but they are unimpressed when they find the Dragon Warrior's day to day life isn't as action packed as they imagined. With this newfound attention flagging, Po releases a demon in order to fight it and impress his fan club.

19.o: It's Dragon Warrior Challenge Day, and if anyone can defeat Po in battle before sundown, they will become the Dragon Warrior.

20.o: Shifu's personal hero arrives at the Jade Palace, but in his overenthusiasm, Shifu accidentally lets him run amok while Temutai schemes to abduct him.

21.o: When the Furious Five go out of town and the Jade Palace is attacked, Po has to rely on a team of elderly Mahjong players for back-up.

22.o: Po's kung fu hero comes to town for an exhibition match.

23.o: Po sets up his father, Mr. Ping, on a series of unsuccessful dates, only to find out Mr. Ping already has a girlfriend. Po's happiness for his dad is short lived when he finds out the mystery lady's identity.

24.o: Po needs to find an awesome Dragon Warrior trophy for the Hall of Heroes or be humiliated in front of the entire village at the upcoming Warrior Festival.

25.o: When Shifu's con-man father comes back into town, Po finds himself in the middle.

26.o: The villagers are outraged over a rash of thefts in the Valley of Peace.

1.o: Tigress must babysit a child who has been separated from his parents. The Croc Bandits are trying to kidnap him for a ransom.

2.o: Master Shifu and the Furious Five meet their newest trainee – The Emperor's Grandson!

3.o: While visiting a famous war hero named General Tsin, Po discovers that the retired general has lost his mind.

4.o: Po comes face to face with hopping ghosts called Jiang Shi which have been sighted around the Valley of Peace's cemetery.

5.o: Po buys shoes that promise to make him better at Kung Fu without the training, but the shoes were created with evil magic and threaten the Furious Five.

6.o: After being defeated by Po, Taotie has a nervous breakdown.

7.o: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu. Part 1 of 2.

8.o: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu. Part 2 of 2.

9.o: Po's the only one unhappy when Peng returns to town, because Po knows who Peng's uncle is.

10.o: Po takes a job as a bounty hunter to earn money to buy his father a gift.

11.o: Po must sit in as master of the Jade Palace when Shifu hurts his back.

12.o: Fung finds an old scroll with instructions for making living terra cotta warriors, and soon it's up to Po and the Furious Five to stop his monstrous clay creations.

13.t: The Spirit Orbs of Master Ding
13.o: When Po is possessed by the ghost of the evil Master Ding, it's up to Tigress to save him before Ding can unleash his powers and enslave the Valley of Peace.

14.o: Po and Mantis visit the equivalent of an ancient Chinese Comic-Con, where Po’s fanboy enthusiasm gets out of hand.

15.o: Po is sad when he learns that everyone has been invited to a dinner party except for him, due to his poor table manners. Will Shifu be able to teach Po proper etiquette AND foil the attack of the evil Temutai and his army?

16.o: When kung fu is outlawed, Po turns to donning a mask to fight crime.

17.o: Po and Tigress must track down and stop a messenger from delivering a scroll that could thrust China into all-out war!

18.o: When Master Mugan from the Garnet Palace decides she needs a new Kung Fu Master, Tigress volunteers. Will the Furious Five be minus one or will Po convince Tigress to return to the Jade Palace?

19.o: Po tries to help Crane get his "mojo" back after he is humiliated at a charity event.

20.t: The Secret Museum of Kung Fu
20.o: With Po and the Furious Five at each other's throats, Shifu takes them all on a disastrous road trip.

21.o: Po saves a girl from some bandits, only to learn that she's engaged to be married to the Dragon Warrior.

22.o: Master Chao visits the valley to oversee a Tournament. Shifu is convinced that Po and Master Chao want to replace him. Shifu's old enemy, Pai Mei, arrives in the middle of the tournament and threatens to destroy Shifu.

23.t: Mama Told Me Not to Kung Fu
23.o: When Crane's mother visits the Valley of Peace, Crane asks his friends to help him keep a secret from her.

24.o: Po plays a prank on Monkey with a fake love letter and their relationship is tested.

25.o: After his father takes him on a wild goose chase, Po becomes embarrassed.

26.o: Mantis ingests a growth potion that makes him huge and inadvertently puts himself and his friends in danger.

1.t: Those are the Eyes of a Beast!
1.o: A former boxer and current drunkard named Danpei Tange meets a drifter named Joe Yabuki and sees potential in him. Tange offers to teach Joe how to box, but Joe isn't easily convinced.

2.t: The Live in the Square Jungle
2.o: Danpei is severely hurt after trying to protect Joe from the yakuza. Joe goes to visit the head of the yakuza group to try to get reparations for Danpei.

3.t: Face the Fangs of the Beast
3.o: Danpei works hard day and night to save up for Joe and his boxing gym. Meanwhile, Joe uses the slum kids to con some money out of people and he runs into a woman named Yoko Shiraki.

4.t: Shed Tears for the Burning Fist!
4.o: Joe holes up in an abandoned building after he gets caught lying to con people out of money.

5.t: For the Sake of Tomorrow! Part 1
5.o: Tange sends Joe a letter to teach him boxing while he's at the police hospital waiting for his fate.

6.o: Joe ends up in a juvenile classification home and is quickly put into his place after trying to be cocky against his fellow inmates and their boss Nishi.

7.o: Joe, Tange, and the kids show up to court to hear if Joe will be sent off to the juvenile training school.

8.o: Joe and Nishi spend their first night at the Toko Special Juvenile Training School and are quickly put into their places.

9.o: Joe and Nishi are sent out with the rest of the inmates to do some farmwork. Later on, Nishi comes up with a plan to help Joe escape the island, but they meet a man named Toru Rikiishi.

10.o: Joe is completely out of it after getting punched by Rikiishi. However, later on, he had a huge surprise in store for everyone.

11.t: Burn at the Bottom of Hell!
11.o: Joe continues to practice boxing while he's alone in solitary. Danpei and the kids try to find a way into the juvenile training school when they unexpectedly run into Yoko.

12.o: Joe tells Yoko why he treats her so badly. Rikiishi tries to interfere and Yoko proposes that they settle this in a boxing match. Tange finally gets to train Joe again in person.

13.t: Stand in the Ring of Destiny
13.o: Joe and Rikiishi prepare for their upcoming match. After seeing just how powerful Joe's new punch is, Rikiishi devises a unique training method to counter it.

14.t: Is it Time for the KO Gong Yet!?
14.o: Joe and Rikiishi finally have their first match. But for some reason, Danpei tells Joe to let Rikiishi keep knocking him down. Who will be the winner in the end?

15.o: Moved by the fight between Joe and Rikiishi, the inmates also start boxing.

16.o: Tange becomes the full-time boxing coach at the juvenile training school on Nogiku Island. Joe seems to finally be interested in training more with Tange, but Tange suddenly seems distant.

17.t: Alone in the Middle of a Storm
17.o: Joe keeps trying to get Tange to coach him again, but Tange just keeps ignoring him and concentrates on training Aoyama. No one expected Aoyama to get into the tournament, but he then somehow defeats the rep for dorm 7, Numata.

18.o: The dormitory boxing tournament begins and everyone finds out just how Aoyama defeated Numata.

19.o: Joe and Aoyama's match finally begins, but who will come out on top?

20.o: Joe and Aoyama's match concludes and Tange reveals something to our two fighters.

21.t: A Small Fight with a Big Honor
21.o: Rikiishi tells Joe that they need to have their match sooner because something came up, so they have an unofficial match out in the rain.

22.o: Rikiishi leaves Toko Special Juvenile Training School and Joe feels empty inside. Meanwhile, the final match of the dorm boxing tournament is about to begin.

23.o: Following Rikiishi and Aoyama, Nishi is also going to leave the juvenile training school, leaving Joe all alone.

24.o: Joe finally leaves the juvenile training school and goes back to the slums where he's welcomed back with open arms, and Danpei has a surprise for him.

25.o: Joe finally feels like something might be changing in his life, but then he is visited by Guerilla, who's on the run from the police.

26.o: Tange goes to the Japan Boxing Association to get his gym officially recognized. Meanwhile, Joe starts working at the grocery store Nishi works at.

27.o: Tange is unable to get the license for his gym, but then, an unexpected visitor gives them an unbelievable offer.

28.o: Joe goes to see the All Japan Rookie Championship Tournament and figures out a way to get one of the members of the Boxing Association to give Tange the license he needs for his gym.

29.o: Tange is able to get the license for his gym after the stunt Joe pulled at the All Japan Rookie Championship Tournament, but he says that Joe's not ready to become a pro yet himself. However, Joe's got his own ideas.

30.t: The Ordeal of the Pro Test
30.o: Joe and Nishi go take the pro boxing test and Joe finds out that it's not as easy as he thought it would be.

31.o: Joe passes the B-rank exam and takes his first real step towards becoming a pro.

32.t: The Road to the Shining Ring
32.o: Nishi and Joe both have their debut matches in the pro ring.

33.o: Everyone celebrates after Joe's first victory. Noriko gets him violets but those are quickly overshadowed by the giant bouquet of roses Yoko sends him.

34.o: Ishikura watches Joe win a boxing match and decides he wants to be just like him. He then suddenly shows up to Tange's gym wanting to join, but Tange surprisingly refuses.

35.o: Nishi loses all three matches so far after becoming a pro and loses his confidence. Tange, Joe, and the kids try to find a way to build his confidence back up and Kinoko finds a surprising solution.

36.o: Joe continues winning match after match and asks Tange when he's going to go up against Wolf Kanagushi. Tange tells him they're going to take it nice and slow, but then, Otaka sends them an invitation...

37.o: Joe, Tange, and Nishi are anxious about what Wolf's secret training could be. The kids decide they'll sneak into the Asia Boxing Club to find out what Wolf's training is, but things go terribly wrong.

38.t: The Greatest Six-Round Bout in History
38.o: Joe and Wolf's match finally begins. Whose training will bring them victory?

39.o: Joe and Wolf's intense match finally comes to an end. Who will stand victorious?

40.o: Tange takes Joe, Nishi, and the rest of the neighborhood on a hot springs trip to celebrate Joe's victory, but on their way up, they find out that Wolf may have been incapacitated.

41.o: The new year has arrived and Joe finds out that Rikiishi is losing weight to become a bantamweight so he can face off with Joe.

42.o: Joe and Rikiishi continue training for their match. However, Rikiishi is starting to worry Yoko and Mikinosuke because he is going to extreme lengths to lose weight.

43.o: Tange formally accepts Shiraki Gym's match request between Rikiishi and Joe and he tells Joe about Rikiishi's brutal weight loss regimen. Meanwhile, Nishi doesn't seem to be losing any weight...

44.o: Rikiishi has his first match as a bantamweight against Pancho Leo. Who will come out on top?

45.o: Joe asks Tange and Nishi to help him improve his sway backs so he has a way to counter Rikiishi.

46.o: While Joe continues his intense training, Rikishi is equally devoted to maintaining his weight.

47.o: On the day of the match, Joe and Danpei reunite with Rikishi during the weigh-in and acknowledge his impressive weight-cutting success.

48.o: Joe realizes that Rikishi has stabilized his body after extreme weight loss.

49.o: Rikishi's uppercut grazes Joe's cheek, causing it to bleed. Alarmed, Joe moves in close during the third round, leading to an intense exchange of hooks.

50.o: Joe fortifies his guard for the first time in his professional career, but Rikishi's fierce attack knocks him down.

51.o: The fierce battle ends. Joe extends a congratulatory handshake to Rikishi, who starts to smile but collapses onto the mat.

52.o: On the day of Rikishi's funeral, Joe leaves their condolences to Danpei and Nishi and tries to distract himself by playing energetically with the children by the riverside.

53.o: Joe wanders through the town on a snowy night, carrying memories of Rikishi. To Joe, who has no family, Rikishi was an irreplaceable presence...

54.o: Three days after Joe disappeared, a ten-count gong was held at Korakuen Hall to mourn Rikishi's death. Joe watches the scene on a street-side TV.

55.o: Joe sees Wolf Kanagushi, who has become a bodyguard for the yakuza, on the streets.

56.o: The brawl with Gondo is treated as extenuating circumstances. After being informed by reporters, Danpei quickly retrieves Joe.

57.o: Joe continues training and lands a powerful body blow during sparring with Nishi. However, Nishi notices that Joe avoids striking the head, arousing suspicion.

58.o: The ten-round match between Joe and Tonotani begins. Danpei and Nishi, concealing their concerns, watch over Joe.

59.o: Having returned to form, Joe defeats several Japanese bantamweight contenders with his fierce body attacks.

60.o: Pre-match predictions favor Tiger in his fight against Joe. Around this time, the head of Bokuto Gym invites Joe to spar with him, saying it is to substitute for Nishi, who injured his fist.

61.o: In the fight against Tiger, Kunimoto, the Sun Gym president, claims to have uncovered Joe's weakness. In truth, Tiger realizes that Joe cannot properly strike the face.

62.o: After the fight, Danpei shockingly reveals the truth to Joe. However, learning that his actual opponent is the 'ghost of Rikishi' haunting him, Joe strengthens his resolve.

63.o: The slump in Joe's performance casts a shadow over the slums. Even so, Joe continues his desperate battle against himself, repeatedly striking the sandbag's temple position.

64.o: Carlos prays for both fighters' success in the ring for Joe's match against Nangou. As the fight begins, Joe faces his poor condition and a referee influenced by the Hyo clan.

65.t: As Long as There's the Ring
65.o: After Joe's devastating loss to Nangou, Danpei dissolves the Tange Gym. He entrusts the future of Joe and Nishi to the proprietor of Hachiya, but Joe resolves to continue boxing alone.

66.o: Joe departs from the Namidabashi Bridge early in the morning and meets a boy who dreams of traveling to far-off places on his way to Ueno Station. Joe sympathizes with his story.

67.o: A postcard arrives, informing the children of Joe's whereabouts in Oarai. Determined to meet him, they head to Ueno Station, but an attempt at fare-dodging is discovered, forcing them to disembark.

68.o: Joe's new career in the traveling show begins. Kawano attempts to promote Joe as a star by arranging fixed matches and instructing the others to take deliberate losses.

69.o: On a day off, Joe goes hiking with Inaba and falls off a cliff in the fog. Yuri, the daughter of a nearby Hiyama Ranch, rescues him.

70.o: Yoko organizes a Carlos vs. Nangou match in Sendai, where Joe performs. Interested in Joe, Carlos and Robert visit the Namidabashi Bridge and learn how much Joe is still loved by the community.

71.o: Joe's performances continue at the sparsely attended Hakusan Shrine. During a break, Joe positions himself in front of the TV Kawano bought, intently watching Carlos's match against Nangou.

72.o: A postcard from Noriko brings news about the Namidabashi community. However, since watching Carlos's fight, Joe has been unable to focus on his performance.

73.o: Returning to Tokyo, Joe visits Yoko and requests to spar with Carlos. Reluctantly, Yoko agrees and insists they use heavier 16-ounce gloves for safety.

74.o: Tange Gym fell into disrepair during Joe's absence. Joe begins rebuilding it with Danpei and the children.

75.o: As Joe resumes training in the Namidabashi slums, Noriko watches with a complex expression. Meanwhile, the day of Carlos's match against Harashima arrives.

76.o: Yoko finalizes the contract for a Carlos vs. Tiger match. Carlos confidently declares he will win with a first-minute KO.

77.o: Robert's old friend, promoter Henry James, arrives in Japan. Henry arranges a match between Carlos and the world champion, Jose Mendoza, and proposes canceling the fight with Joe.

78.o: The day of Carlos's match against Tiger arrives. As a boxing fan, Danpei expresses his feelings about Joe's journey. Yoko quietly encourages Joe as they pass in the hallway.

79.t: Let the Shining Tomorrow Burn in the Distance!!
79.o: Carlos counters Joe's rope-side techniques with an improvised move, nullifying Joe's strategy. He then proposes an all-out brawl with no tricks.

1.o: Wei Yingluo enters the Forbidden Palace as a maid to investigate her sister's death. The Emperor oversees the Hall Selection of new concubines and sends a reminder to the Harem on their conduct.

2.o: Yingluo’s attitude and abilities create tension in the Embroidery Workshop. Noble Consort Gao's involvement in Lady Yu's health leads to a confrontation, as the Empress continues to struggle with her management of the Harem. Yingluo encounters the Emperor for the first time.

3.o: Yingluo’s initial investigations into her sister's demise attract the attention of Momo Fang, and Yingluo is forced to improvise. Head Chamberlain Li Yu mounts a search for her after the tense encounter with the Emperor.

4.o: Guard Fucha Fuheng attempts to rouse his sister the Empress from her long-held grief. Noble Consort Gao and Consort Jia continue their scheming, leading to Yingluo being summoned.

5.o: Yingluo must think quickly when confronted by Noble Consort Gao. Momo Fang continues to seek retribution, and believes she has found an opportunity when rumours swirl around Yingluo’s conduct.

6.o: Yingluo considers how to gain access to the owner of a pendant who may be implicated in her sister’s death. The Emperor muses over his apparent rejection by one of his Consorts, while simultaneously spurning another close to him. The Embroidery Workshop is thrown into disarray when plans for the Empress’ birthday present go awry.

7.o: Yingluo’s quick thinking impresses the Empress, as the hunt continues for the one responsible for destroying the peacock thread. Yingluo and Linglong both aim to settle scores as they compete for a prestigious assignment.

7.o: Tully's mom disappoints her again and again, and Kate's boozy night with her best friend and their coworkers causes awkwardness, accusations and hurt.

8.o: Vows are made and hearts broken as Kate navigates her long-strained relationship with her brother, and Tully grapples with compromise and commitment.

9.o: After one of Tully's birthdays ends in disaster, Kate becomes devoted to making her friend's big day special, even if her efforts don't always succeed.

10.o: Over holidays past and present, relationships shift — and truths are spoken — as Tully and Kate reshape their expectations for what the future holds.

3.o: A teen magazine. A political investigation. A secret message. Shocking revelations lead to major questions for Sean, Tully and Kate.

4.o: As Tully's career takes off, uncomfortable encounters at work keep throwing her off track. Johnny's behavior causes concern among his loved ones.

5.o: From a double date in 1975 to Tully's search for her father in 2004, Tully and Kate attempt to take charge of their futures — but fate has other plans.

6.o: While celebrating their own freedom on Independence Day, Tully and Kate learn time and again that relying on each other may not be so bad after all.

7.o: Tully attempts to face unresolved loose ends from her past. But her choices lead to a potentially unforgivable mistake that impacts Kate's life.

8.o: Kate learns that dealing with an ex is always tricky, no matter the decade. After years of never saying sorry, Tully struggles with accountability.

9.o: For the first time in decades, Kate and Tully experience a year apart — but can they handle major life events without each other?

10.o: Kate has often felt invisible next to Tully through the years. But amid major changes, Kate realizes she may need her best friend by her side.

11.t: The Breast Is Yet To Come
11.o: From bra-stuffing to breastfeeding, Kate experiences several bumps in the road on her journey from a self-conscious teen to a first-time mother.

13.o: A bridal shower stirs up resentments and memories, an awkward encounter leads to a life-changing question, and a tragedy shakes teenage Kate's world.

14.t: I Can’t Go On, I’ll Go On
14.o: Kate and Johnny's loved ones gather for two very different celebrations. Tully gets tangled in a romantic dilemma, and Kate feels the weight of a secret.

15.o: Tully, Johnny and Marah try to find ways of coping after Kate's revelation. In the 1980s, Johnny wrestles with another piece of overwhelming news.

16.o: On a special day for the Mularkey family, Tully reflects on decades of work, love, grief and joy alongside her best friend. Kate faces the unknown.

1.o: The Novas, a family of space explorers make an interstellar discovery that will change the course of history when they chance across an alien space craft and its ethereal substance - Star Dust.

2.o: Bored with cataloguing rocks, Adelaide accepts a challenge to a "space-race" against Sol. But when Sol gets in trouble, Adelaide and Jet perform a heroic rescue and rediscover what being a Nova is all about.

3.o: When Jet creates a nutrient-dense 'super pickle', it attracts a space hamster whose survival instinct puts the whole port in great danger. Jet will have to free his new friend in order to guarantee Luna Port's safety.

4.o: After crash landing while on a supply run to a research planet, the Novas come face-to-face with green-skinned natives and a deadly gravity storm that threatens not only their lives but some life-saving research!

5.o: The Novas travel to a suspected Star Dust Planet, but instead find themselves trapped underwater by a sentient seaweed plant. Meanwhile, Aubrina sends Sol out undercover to learn what the Novas are up to.

6.o: When a large comet appears on a collision course with Luna Port, the Novas take a huge risk to divert it, only to realise it's no comet at all, but rather a frozen spaceship presumed lost for nearly 100 years!

7.o: Continuing their search for Star Dust aliens, the Novas discover an uninhabited planet - but when they fall through quicksand to the caverns beneath, they soon discover it isn't uninhabited at all!

8.o: After G9 malfunctions at a Luna Port celebration, Aubrina seeks to reprogram him. Jet and Adelaide go on a mission to save their robot only to find Aubrina has some secrets of her own!

9.o: After the Novas are forced to land on a junk planet for repairs, they come face-to-face with Old Phil and his dog Calisto. Phil claims that he enjoys solitude and quiet, but he may know more than he is letting on!

10.o: Sol attempts to win the science fair by sabotaging all the other projects including Jet and Adelaide's half plant, half animal. But Sol's actions cause chaos and reveal an alien may have been to Luna Port!

11.o: Josie surprises the Novas by booking a 'ghost tour' of a spooky space station. But when they receive a distress call from the station, they realise this ghost tour may be more real than they bargained for!

12.o: The Novas expose Aubrina's wrongdoing and the Star Dust Crystal is returned. They're ready to make their first Star Dust 'jump' and explore unknown parts of space but Aubrina enlists a shadowy figure to stop the Novas!

13.o: The Novas are now able to jump millions of lightyears and their quest to find Star Dust Aliens kicks into high gear. But on their first trip, Jet and Adelaide realise that an alien might be closer to home than they realised.

14.o: The Novas and Sol begin their search for Sol's home planet. Their first stop leads them on a mission to a planet inhabited entirely by mega-flora - only for Sol to go missing.

15.o: When the Novas and Sol go to investigate a potential Star Dust Ship - they get trapped on a rogue planet heading directly towards the system's sun! Meanwhile, Aubrina has plans to get her own Star Dust crystal.

16.o: The Novas investigate a seemingly deserted planet, millions of lightyears away with pyramid-like temples. Soon, however, they find the planet isn't deserted, and the inhabitants aren't the type looking for a friendly chat!

17.t: A Black Hole Ate My Homework
17.o: When Jet and Adelaide realise they have too much work to get through in one night, they devise a plan to take Adelaide's flyer to the very edge of a black hole in order to slow down time.

18.o: The Novas discover the escape pod that Jet used to evacuate Pickles the space hamster into uncharted space. When they finally catch up with Pickles however, they find he and his family need their help more than ever.

19.t: Pamela Barnacle Is Alive and Well
19.o: Luna Port's security system is malfunctioning, so the Novas visit Pamela Barnacle, the system's creator at her private asteroid. But when they arrive they find there's more than meets the eye with Pamela and her creation.

20.o: The Novas spot a planet that looks like paradise so they decide to visit for some much-needed R&R. Soon, however, their dream getaway turns into a nightmare - and one that they're unable to wake up from!

21.o: The Novas head to an Earth-like planet, hoping to find the Star Dust Aliens. Instead, they find highly evolved and aggressive Alien dinosaurs, and discover what it's like when Humans are at the bottom of the food chain!

22.o: In the middle of a grav-ball game against their arch-rivals, Luna Port faces a catastrophic shut-down and blackout. It's now up to Jet, Adelaide and Sol to get the port back online before it crashes into an asteroid belt!

23.o: One of the Novas' drones delivers footage that will make them question everything they know about alien life; a blurry video of what looks like a real-life bigfoot on a planet millions of light years from Earth!

24.o: Sol has vivid dreams about his home world, so the Novas enlist the help of their 'energy creature' friend to uncover details of his planet. But things take a turn when Sol's brain refuses to release him from the dream state!

25.o: The Novas journey to Sol's home planet - only to discover that it is completely frozen over. But they soon realise the planet may yet hold the answers to all their questions - but first they must journey below the ice.

26.o: The Novas locate another Alien rock ship and set off to make contact. But they're intercepted by Aubrina and left stranded. Will the Novas lose their chance to make real contact with the Star Dust Aliens forever?

1.o: During the battle in Pingling City, Jinxiu’s military commander, Fu Yi Xiao, severely injures Susha’s eldest Prince, Feng Sui Ge, who quickly flees for safety. Meanwhile, Fu Yi Xiao becomes the target of assassins and is also severely injured, trying to escape. Both survive with the help of the physicians from Zhengnian Villa. As they try to speed recovery using the hidden medicine pool, they meet again, but Fu Yi Xiao has lost her memory, and Feng Sui Ge takes advantage of this.

2.o: Feng Sui Ge tortures Fu Yi Xiao to gain information about the battle at Pingling and, in so doing, helps her remember some of her past memories. He decides to keep her alive, hoping to figure out who tried to assassinate them. They head back to the palace, but are stopped at the city gates while Sui Ge’s brother completes his coming-of-age ceremony. Meanwhile, Jinxiu’s Prince Xia Jing Shi is forced to marry Susha’s princess for diplomatic peace.

3.o: Before striking a deal to cooperate with each other, Yi Xiao and Sui Ge get even with each other. Yi Xiao lures the assassins following her, but they hold back for some reason. The Prime Minister pressures his daughter, Empress Zhang, to prepare Princess Feng Xi Yang, Sui Ge’s sister, for marriage with the Prince of Jinxiu. Three little kids end up in Zhengnian Villa looking for their missing master.

4.o: Sui Ge comes up with a plan to not only confirm his cooperation with Yi Xiao, but also to surface the assassins after her. Xue Ying arrives at the capital, bringing Yi Xiao’s three little disciples. However, Yi Xiao is wary of them since she is unable to remember her past with them. News from Jinxiu arrives, and the imperial court ministers debate the marriage proposal between the Princess of Sasha and the Prince of Jinxiu for peace.

5.o: Sui Ge tells his sister Jinxiu’s plan to have her marry the Prince of Jinxiu, Xia Jing Shi, who is in love with Yi Xiao. Sui Ge vows to protect her and prevent her marriage. Yi Xiao entrusts her little disciples to Xue Ying, but things go awry when the disciples run away and A’Fang goes missing. Yi Xiao looks for him and falls into her assassin’s trap. Jing Shi receives news that Yi Xiao is alive and heads for Yujing to save her from Sui Ge.

6.o: Sui Ge discovers that his sister has fallen in love with the Prince of Jinxiu and therefore wants to marry him. Shocked and angry that she could marry his sworn enemy, Sui Ge blames himself for her naïveté because he shielded her from treacherous people while growing up. Concerned by his sudden change in behavior, Yi Xiao accompanies Sui Ge as he tries to drown away his sorrows. Meanwhile, the Prince of Jinxiu makes haste for Yujing.

7.o: Sui Ge calls upon Yi Xiao to help him find his most skilled archer, who has gone rogue, thinking to relieve Sui Ge of his burdens by killing Xia Jing Shi, the Prince of Jinxiu. Yi Xiao agrees on the condition that Sui Ge concedes to five of her terms and conditions. She accompanies Sui Ge to watch Jing Shi’s arrival, and past memories resurface upon seeing him. Meanwhile, Princess Xi Yang meets with Jing Shi and recounts how they first met during battle, years before.

8.o: Princess Xi Yang is melancholy after learning that Jing Shi’s heart belongs to another woman. The Empress meets with Jing Shi to confirm his feelings for Yi Xiao, fearing Xi Yang will withdraw from the betrothal. Ning Fei and Wei Ran plead with Xue Ying to help them meet with Yi Xiao. Fearing for her safety, Sui Ge restrains Yi Xiao from meeting her Jinxiu comrades, but Yi Xiao finds a way to meet face-to-face with Jing Shi.

9.o: Despite remembering past events with Jing Shi, Yi Xiao makes it clear to him that she does not harbor the same affections for him as he does for her, which distresses him. Jing Shi tries to bring her back to Jinxiu as part of the marriage alliance negotiations, while Sui Ge prepares a surprise for him. To ascertain which of her close friends tried to kill her, she gets Ning Fei and Wei Ran drunk. Xi Yang meets with Yi Xiao, and together they run into both Jing Shi and Sui Ge while walking the city streets.

10.o: Yi Xiao catches a glimpse of Jing Shi’s pendant, prompting memories of her falling off the cliff. She decides to stay close to him, secretly asking Sui Ge for help. She discovers Jing Shi suffers from poisoning, but he keeps the details of this hidden, as it relates to his grand plan. Sui Ge awaits a response from the Emperor of Jinxiu as he, too, has grand plans of his own. Upset that Jing Shi shows a preference for Yi Xiao, the Empress enacts her own plan to ensure Jing Shi remains true to Xi Yang.

11.o: The Emperor of Jinxiu happily accepts Sui Ge’s proposal to keep Jing Shi in Susha after the wedding with his sister, as it allows him to take control of Jing Shi’s army. Yi Xiao continues to probe Ning Fei, Wei Ran, and Jing Shi about what happened after the battle in Pingling, and their differing responses make her more suspicious of Wei Ran and Jing Shi. She trades intel with Sui Ge so that she can pursue her other leads, while Prime Minister Zhuang Shen makes his move against Sui Ge.

12.o: Prime Minister Zhuang’s plan fails when the Emperor receives word from the Emperor of Jinxiu accepting Jing Shi’s matrilocal marriage with Xi Yang. Upon hearing the news, Jing Shi sets out to meet with his Susha contact while Sui Ge’s men lie in wait. Assassins target Yi Xia,o and though she is able to fight them off, she is unexpectedly forced to confront her true enemy. Xi Yang confronts Sui Ge, accusing him of using her marriage to Jing Shi to trap him in Susha.

13.o: Sui Ge’s plan falls into place when Ning Fei realizes the truth and confronts Wei Ran. Yi Xiao hears everything, vowing they are no longer sworn siblings, but strangers henceforth. Ning Fei collapses after being shot by a poisoned arrow during his scuffle with Yi Xiao’s assassins. Sui Ge finds Xue Ying’s father, who figures out a way to help Ning Fei. Meanwhile, Jing Shi uses his contact in Susha to set Wei Ran free.

14.o: Yi Xiao confronts Jing Shi and learns the truth behind her fall after the Pingling battle, and declares he will be her enemy henceforth. Sui Ge takes Yi Xiao to his mother’s residence in the woods and acknowledges his promise to Yi Xiao, granting her freedom now that she’s uncovered who tried to kill her. He then heads to meet with the Emperor to get justice for Yi Xiao, who was targeted by the Empress.

15.o: Sui Ge angers his father when he accuses him of turning a blind eye to the Empress’ actions in trying to kill Yi Xiao. Sui Ge is removed as the secondary officiant in the Ancestral Ceremony and replaced by his younger brother, indicating Sui Ge is no longer favored by the Emperor. Knowing he’s upset, Yi Xiao takes Sui Ge to a place to help calm him and, in so doing, learns the story behind his mother’s death. Murong Yao and his father arrive to attend Xi Yang’s wedding, and though Murong Yao is to keep tabs on Jing Shi, Jing Shi suddenly disappears.

16.o: While following a lead to the masked man working with Jing Shi, Yi Xiao spots a familiar face and unexpectedly falls into a trap in a death camp. She learns who the mastermind behind it all is, while Sui Ge discovers another lead to Manager Luo. Sui Ge and his sister mend their relationship before her royal wedding, with Sui Ge promising to attend. All the while, Sui Ge and Yi Xiao slowly grow closer together.

17.o: Sui Ge begins to share his true feelings for Yi Xiao. Despite Jing Shi’s apathy towards Xi Yang on their wedding night, Xi Yang pledges to be by his side and gives him the gift of freedom. Sui Ge pursues them, intending to bring them back to the capital, and Yi Xiao follows, knowing Jing Shi has other motives. During the confrontation, Jing Shi targets Sui Ge, while Yi Xiao targets Jing Shi, putting her injured left arm at risk of permanent damage.

18.o: Not believing that Ning Fei is dead, Jing Shi commands Wei Ran to look for him. Xue Ying’s father performs surgery on Yi Xiao’s injured left arm. Sui Ge defies his father’s summons to attend the imperial court to ensure Yi Xiao’s surgery goes well, then meets with his father alone to seek punishment. However, his father suddenly falls ill soon after meeting him, and a confrontation between him and the Empress ensues. Yi Xiao catches a glimpse of the masked man’s carriage.

19.o: Sui Ge convinces Yi Xiao to leave the capital, knowing she will be targeted by the imperial ministers. Yi Xiao sets an elaborate trap to capture Ru Yan and use her as the bait for the masked man. However, she is caught off guard when she finds out the identity of the masked man, and he intercepts her before she can warn Sui Ge. Meanwhile, Sui Ge’s investigation leads him to Jing Shi’s death warriors and their attempt to assassinate the imperial minister of war.

20.o: While Yi Xiao tries to convince Ru Yan to move on with her life, Sui Ge focuses on getting the identity of the masked man by interrogating the death warriors. The Empress Dowager of Jinxiu and her son, the Emperor, scheme to keep control of Jing Shi now that he’s back. Prime Minister Zhuang takes control of the imperial court, planning to replace Sui Ge’s only supporter with his own. Things come to a head when the Prime Minister insinuates the Emperor’s current state is caused by Sui Ge.

21.o: Yi Xiao thinks of a way to control Murong Yao since she’s not able to tell Sui Ge the truth about him. Back in Jinxiu, the Emperor finds ways to ridicule and exert his dominance over Jing Shi, while Jing Shi slowly bides his time. Lord Ling makes it known that the Emperor has a terminal illness he’s been keeping secret for the past 15 years. Prime Minister Zhuang begins influencing the ministers to make Sui Ge’s brother the next emperor, but surprisingly wants to keep the Emperor alive.

22.o: The Empress and Prime Minister Zhuang sow discord between Sui Ge and his brother, forcing his brother to accept becoming the next emperor when his father dies. Yi Xiao makes the difficult decision to tell Sui Ge the truth about the masked man’s identity, wondering if Sui Ge would believe her…

23.o: With Murong Yao’s father held captive by Yi Xiao, Murong Yao and Prime Minister Zhuang are at odds over how to deal with the Emperor. With the help of his nephew, Prime Minister Zhuang obtains what he needs to enact revenge against the Emperor. Realizing his father is at the mercy of Murong Yao, Sui Ge summons his Qionqi Unit and Feng Battalion to seize control of his father’s protection.

24.o: Intent on keeping his father alive, Sui Ge storms the palace and confronts Prime Minister Zhuang, who has assembled the imperial guards to thwart Sui Ge. Meanwhile, Jing Shi entrusts his plans to overthrow his brother to Xi Yang, but his brother’s interest in Xi Yang sows a seed of doubt in Jing Shi. In his attempt to find his father, Sui Ge comes face-to-face with the reality of his mother’s death.

25.o: The Emperor continues to justify his actions, but both Sui Ge and Yi Xiao don’t agree with his principles, with Sui Ge refusing to be his successor. Murong Yao finds his father, but his father is disappointed in what his son has become. Prime Minister Zhuang continues with his plans for revenge, enlisting his nephew, Zhuang Ming. Meanwhile, Xi Yang becomes embittered by her loveless marriage to Jing Shi.

26.o: The Emperor of Jinxiu spares no effort in helping Xi Yang realize how cruel Jing Shi really is. He makes it known to her that her father is deathly ill, but try as she might, she is not able to leave and visit him. Prime Minister Zhuang’s plan goes into effect, even sacrificing innocent people in the process. Things culminate to the point of finally exposing the truth behind Sui Ge’s mother’s death.

27.o: Sui Ge finally avenges his mother’s wrongful death and then bids farewell to his father, not wanting to do anything more with him. As he and his men celebrate, the Empress confronts the Emperor with devastating consequences. Murong Zhong lies in wait, looking for someone who can help protect his son from his treasonous crimes.

28.o: The Empress colludes with Murong Zhong to pin the Emperor’s death on Sui Ge. Though Murong Yao heeds his father’s commands, he still holds brotherly love for Sui Ge. Yi Xiao, along with Sui Ge’s men, fights with all their might to save Sui Ge, but it comes at a high cost. Meanwhile, Xi Yang regrets marrying Jing Shi, proclaiming she has divorced him. As news of the Emperor’s and Sui Ge’s deaths circulates, Jing Yan is anxious to be rid of Jing Shi.

29.o: Upon arriving at the Storm Alliance, Yi Xiao faces obstacles in getting treatment for Sui Ge. Despite the Storm Alliance’s grim history with the Fengs, Yi Xiao makes a case for Sui Ge using the basic principles upon which the Storm Alliance was founded. Xi Yang vows not only to rely on herself moving forward, but also to take revenge on those who murdered her father and brother.

30.o: Cheng Yang ascends the throne but is already cautioned to be wary of the Murong family, while the Murong family plots to stay in power. Jing Shi gathers his men and makes his move, while Xi Yang makes a sacrifice to learn who was behind the deaths of her father and brother. Although Sui Ge is saved, he’s not completely in the clear, health-wise. He and Yi Xiao weigh the costs and benefits of further treatment.

31.o: Xi Yang is incredulous after hearing the reports of what happened in Susha. Disbelieving, she asks Jing Yan to continue investigating and slowly aligns herself with him. Realizing Jing Yan is infatuated with Xi Yang, the Empress of Jinxiu looks to Jing Shi to attack Susha. Yi Xiao discovers that the man who had lost his memories still remembers his wife, so she takes a gamble with her life and confronts Sui Ge.

32.o: Yi Xiao’s gamble pays off, but now they must find a way to leave the premises of Storm Alliance. Elders Zhou and Zhang have plans of their own, counter to Elder Lei. Xi Yang makes a bet with Jing Yan and wins after exposing Jing Shi’s planted spy. Meanwhile, back at Susha, Emperor Cheng Yang learns more about the death of his father.

33.o: Sui Ge and Yi Xiao deduce what Elders Zhou and Zhang are planning and make their own plans. Elder Lei realizes how stifling the rules are, while Sui Ge vows to find who was behind the Storm Alliance massacre. Emperor Cheng Yang confronts his mother and learns the truth. Xi Yang makes another wager with Jing Yan. Sui Ge finally reunites with his brothers in arms.

34.o: Sui Ge’s men give him updates on the happenings at the palace. Sui Ge decides to schedule a meeting with his brother, Cheng Yang. The Empress Dowager can no longer stand Xi Yang and does everything in her power to get rid of her. Xi Yang tries to persuade Jing Yan to help kill the Murongs, while Jing Shi plans on dealing with Xi Yang.

35.o: Sui Ge and his team are suddenly ambushed by Murong Yao. Sui Ge decides to seek out his Feng battalion to see if they will still stand with him. The Empress Dowager leans more and more heavily on Jing Shi, who decides to finally make his move. Cheng Yang’s suspicions are validated when his mother decides to wrest control from him and place him under house arrest.

36.o: With his powers stripped by Cheng Yang, Murong Yao heads back to his residence, finding Sui Ge and his battalion waiting for him. Xi Yang receives a letter from Sui Ge and pleads with Jing Yan to allow her to see him. Worried for Xi Yang’s safety, Sui Ge immediately heads off to Jinxiu. Xi Yang receives alarming news that changes Jing Shi’s plans for attack.

37.o: Xi Yang promises Jing Yan that if he allows her to see her brother, she will stay with him on his birthday. Knowing Sui Ge will take his sister away, Jing Yan heartbrokenly agrees. Yi Xiao and Ning Fei confront Wei Ran and realize Jing Shi will make his move soon. Worried, Sui Ge chases after Xi Yang, who has left to spend time with Jing Yan on his birthday.

38.o: Jing Shi finally gets the revenge he’s been planning and waiting for, but is dismayed when Yi Xiao makes it clear she only sees him as her enemy. Sui Ge gathers his men for a showdown with Jing Shi, who has prepared an ambush. Unwilling to accompany the dead Emperor in the mausoleum, the Empress Zhuang makes her own plans for her future. In the aftermath, Sui Ge leaves the governmental affairs to Xi Yang, while Cheng Yang lives in seclusion in Youqi temple, and Sui Ge mourns for 3 years before deciding what to do next.

1.o: يتعثر إيقاع الحياة اليومية لمنتجة القصص الرقمية المصورة "مي راي سيو" تحت وطأة ضغوط العمل، لكنه يزداد ارتباكًا حين تلوح لها فرصة ساحرة لتجربة خدمة مواعدة افتراضية جديدة.

2.o: تأسر أول مواعدة افتراضية قلب "مي راي" تمامًا، وتغرق في الحياة الباذخة للطبقة الراقية... وتتخذ ذلك كسلاح حين تجد نفسها في منافسة مع "كيونغ نام بارك".

3.o: تذهب "مي راي" لموعدها الغرامي الثاني في الحرم الجامعي، حيث يلعب الشخص الذي تواعده دور صعب المنال، فيما تعاودها ذكريات حبها الأول.

4.o: بعدما تنتهي الفترة التجريبية المجانية فجأة، تدفع "مي راي" ثمنًا باهظًا للاستمتاع بالمواعدة الافتراضية إلى أقصى درجة ممكنة... يا له من استثمار عوائده تبهج القلب دون أي مخاطرة!

5.o: تعاود "مي راي" التواصل مع شخص من ماضيها في موعد غرامي يمنحها شعورًا مختلفًا، فيما تفجّر ورشة عمل لفريق "نيمو" اعترافًا مُحرجًا.

6.o: تخيب آمال "مي راي" في موعد أحلامها بعد خروجها مع المرشح التالي، لكنها تقرر العودة إلى استخدام التطبيق بعد تلقيها نصيحة توقظها من أوهامها.

7.o: مع تداخل العالم الحقيقي بالافتراضي في حياة "مي راي"، يُطلب منها إعداد خطة للعبة لـ"سونغ يون"، مما يفضي إلى لقاء جماعي مفاجئ.

8.o: حين تظهر علاقة واقعية تتسبب بدفع "مي راي" خارج هالة المواعدة الافتراضية، تتهاوى دفاعاتها وتعود مخاوفها من الوحدة لتطفو على السطح من جديد.

9.o: تجد الكاتبة "يون" نفسها تحت ضغط مع قرب انتهاء عقدها مع دار النشر "نيمو"، فتسعى جاهدة إلى احتلال الصدارة وسط ترقّب فضيحة وشيكة. وفي أثناء ذلك، يكتشف "كيونغ نام" سرّ "مي راي".

10.o: تبحث "مي راي" عن النصح في العالم الافتراضي بعد أن حيرتها رسائل متناقضة ومواقف شابها سوء الفهم. فهل تعثر على الأجوبة التي تنشدها وطريقٍ جديد يفتح قلبها للحب؟
